title: ornithopus sativus var. macrorrhynchus
intro: Ornithopus sativus var. macrorrhynchus, commonly known as White Medick or Hoop Clover, is a perennial legume that belongs to the Fabaceae family. This plant has been used for its various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and lower cholesterol levels. The therapeutic actions of Ornithopus sativus var. macrorrhynchus include its ability to act as a demulcent, emollient, and diuretic, making it useful for treating skin conditions, wounds, and urinary issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are still being studied for their potential health benefits.
